review: Tingtang Hong Lu is an ID that wants to roll heads and only heads. All of his skills consist of doing really good bonus damage if they hit heads and a really big cutdown on enemies that are at low health. His Uptie 4 only makes him scale with bleed on target, which might turn him into a pretty insane DPS on a bleed team if it becomes a good choice to run. No notable E.G.O. Synergies
